lines: You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Chive Scrambled Sourdough
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs with fresh chives on toasted sourdough
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs with chopped chives. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and scramble the eggs until just set. Serve immediately on toasted sourdough.
dishes.why: A high-protein breakfast to kickstart muscle gain for the day.

dishes.name: Seed-Butter Chive Toast
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs and sunflower seed butter on sourdough
dishes.method: Scramble the eggs with chives in the oil. Toast the sourdough and spread with sunflower seed butter before topping with the warm eggs.
dishes.why: Using sunflower seed butter as a safe, high-energy alternative to one of the foods on your medical list.

dishes.name: Lemon Chicken and Couscous
dishes.title: Pan-seared lemon chicken with green beans and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, couscous, and green beans in a pan with a splash of water. Finish with a fresh squeeze of lemon juice.
dishes.why: A balanced meal with starch following your morning activity to support muscle gain.

dishes.name: Lemon Chicken and Couscous
dishes.title: Pan-seared lemon chicken with green beans and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, couscous, and beans in a pan. Serve with a fresh lemon wedge.
dishes.why: A clean, allergen-free lunch that meets your protein needs for muscle gain.

dishes.name: Spinach and Red Lentil Dhal
dishes.title: Warm red lentil dhal with spinach and basmati rice
dishes.method: Reheat the dhal and rice in a pan over medium heat. Add a splash of water if the dhal has thickened too much.
dishes.why: A warm, iron-rich plant protein dinner that is easy on the kitchen during painting.

dishes.name: Spinach and Red Lentil Dhal
dishes.title: Warm red lentil dhal with spinach and basmati rice
dishes.method: Warm the rice and dhal in a pan until steaming. Serve with the protein and starch first as requested.
dishes.why: A filling, warm dinner that avoids celeriac and supports recovery.

preparations.title: Pan-seared lemon chicken thighs
preparations.method: Season the chicken with oregano, salt, and pepper. Heat oil in a large pan and sear the thighs for 6-8 minutes per side until cooked through and golden.

preparations.title: Spiced red lentil and spinach dhal
preparations.method: Sauté the onion, garlic, and spices in oil. Add lentils and 450ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes until soft. Stir in the spinach at the end until wilted.

preparations.title: Steamed basmati rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice and boil in salted water for 12-15 minutes until tender. Drain and fluff with a fork.

preparations.title: Soaked couscous
preparations.method: Place couscous in a bowl and cover with an equal volume of boiling water. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes, then fluff.

preparations.title: Steamed green beans
preparations.method: Trim the beans and steam over boiling water for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the dhal and the rice on the hobs. While they simmer, sear the chicken thighs in a large pan. Steam the green beans in a colander over the rice pot. Soak the couscous in a separate bowl. Once everything is cooked, portion into the named boxes immediately.
